Once upon a time there was a very fragile bird. She lived in a lovely tree in the woods. Every day she went out and searched for tasty bugs.

Once upon a time there was a very clean little machine. It was a very special machine that only one person could manage.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy night. Everyone was so relaxed. All the animals were cozy in their beds. But one little bunny had something special in mind!

When he woke up again, he remembered that it was a lazy night. He hopped down from the tree and scurried back home. He was so happy and soon fell asleep, dreaming about his lazy night.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Jacob. Jacob liked to go to the park and play. One day, he went to the park to look for his friends.

As he walked, he saw an orange bird perched on a branch of a tree. Jacob was amazed and he whispered, "What is that beautiful bird?".

The orange bird started to pray to God. Jacob joined in, and together they prayed for happiness. As they finished praying, the orange bird flew away.

Once upon a time, there was a shy little bird named Tweety. One day, he went for a walk around the park. As he was walking, he slipped on a banana peel and fell to the ground. He tried to fly away, but he hurt his wing. Upset, he started to cry. 

A kindly veterinarian saw him and took him in. She said to him, "Don't worry little Tweety, I can help." Tweety, still feeling shy, just nodded. 

The veterinarian said, "I'll have to take care of your wing for a few days so that you can fly again. Can you come back tomorrow?" Tweety nodded and the veterinarian smiled. 

The next day, Tweety came back. He was feeling much better and flew around the park again. He never slipped again and was happy he had been able to find help!

Once upon a time there was a girl named Daisy. Daisy carried her little pet mole in her arms - it was so small and cute! Everyone thought the little mole was very attractive and admired it very much.

One day, Daisy was playing in the park when a boy named Andy saw the mole. "What's that?" he asked her. Daisy beamed and said, "It's my pet mole". 

Andy asked if he could pet the mole, Daisy said yes and Andy gently stroked the mole's head. The mole felt happy and curled up in Daisy's arms and made little squeaky noises.

Andy smiled at Daisy, "Your mole is very attractive," he said. Daisy smiled back and said, "Thank you, Andy". Then, Daisy and Andy played together in the park until it was time to go home. Daisy carefully carried her mole all the way home.

Once upon a time, there was a small duck. He had a big sailboat. The duck loved to sail around the lake in his boat.

One day, the duck was out sailing when it started to rain. He quickly paddled back to shore, but the rain kept coming down.

The duck was so wet that he couldn't get the sailboat. Then he heard a voice. It was loud and friendly.

"Hey duck! I can help you, if you want", said the voice.

The duck looked around and saw an old man. He was deaf, so he shouted when he spoke. The old man had a big box of cream.

"I'm making ice cream with this cream. Would you like some?"

"Yes please!" said the duck.

So the old man scooped the creamy ice cream into a cone, and the duck ate it up. He was so happy!

Once the duck was full, the old man helped him put the sailboat back onto the lake. The old man waved goodbye as the duck began to sail away.

The duck sailed around the lake, feeling happy and free. He was so glad he had met the old man!

Once upon a time there was a clumsy bear who wanted to find some food. He looked and looked but couldn't find anything.

He was feeling very sad, when he spotted a cave. He was hoping he might find something tasty to eat inside.

The bear walked into the cave. "Hello!" he called out.

A little mouse poked his head out. "What do you want?" he asked the bear.

"I'm looking for something to eat," said the bear.

The mouse smiled. "I've got just the thing!" he said, scurrying off into a corner and coming back with some tasty berries.

"Yum!" said the bear as he ate the berries.

The mouse watched as the clumsy bear stumbled around the cave, eating the berries.

When the bear was done, he thanked the mouse for the delicious snack.

"You're welcome," said the mouse. "Come by any time you're hungry!"

The bear smiled and waved goodbye as he walked out of the cave, much happier than when he had arrived.

Bob was a three year old child. He liked to play outside and slide down the slide in his backyard.

One day, Bob's mom told him that she was getting married. "What is marriage?" asked Bob.

"Marriage is when two people love each other and decide to stay together forever," His mom explained to him.

Suddenly, Bob saw a big dead bug on the slide. "Oh no!" he said in surprise.

His mom came to check what was wrong. "Don't worry," she said, "It's just a dead bug."

Bob said, "But why is it dead?" 

His mom smiled and said, "Some things just don't last forever - like marriage." 

Bob smiled and thought, "I understand now - marriage is forever." He accepted the bug as a symbol of commitment, understanding and love.

Once upon a time, there lived an enthusiastic girl called Daisy. Every morning Daisy would bow to the sun and say a cheery hello. She was always in a very good mood and brightened up everyone's day.

Once upon a time there was a boy named Alex. He wanted so much to eat some chocolate but his mom said he had to wait. Alex was very impatient.

One day, two cousins, Alex and June, went to the park. Alex ran over the to the swing and jumped eagerly onto it.

Once upon a time there was a clumsy boy. His name was Tommy. He loved to touch things.

Once upon a time there was a beautiful ranch. The ranch was filled with colorful animals such as horses, cows and goats.

Once upon a time, there was a lovely otter who lived in a river. Every day he swam around, exploring and looking for food. One day, he saw a big fish and he was so excited! He tried to swim faster, but the fish was just too fast for him.

Once upon a time there was a brave boy named Tom. He was always looking for new things to explore. One day, he was walking in the forest when he noticed something strange. He saw a big rock with a golden nail sticking up from the top.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lily. Lily was only three years old and loved to explore the world. She didn't know what could be in the woods and often played around it.

One day, as she was walking, she heard something strange coming from a jar by her feet. When she opened it, a big, scary monster was inside. The monster was so terrible that she screamed.

Once upon a time there was a giant. He was tall, strong, and always smiled. Everywhere he went people thanked him for his kindness.

Once upon a time there was a smart girl called Jane. Jane asked her parents for money every day. Her parents said, "No! You have to work for your money!"

Ted was walking around the park and he felt shy. He looked around but everyone was busy. He noticed a mug lying on the grass. Ted was curious and he slowly walked towards it.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Joe and Jane. Joe and Jane were having fun playing together in the sunshine. Suddenly, it began to get very hot and Jane started to fan herself with a big, bright fan. Joe wanted the fan too, and so they had to fight over it.

One day, there was a yellow bull. He was very happy and running through the field. He turned around and around and around. Suddenly, he stopped and saw a big tree. He saw a big rock and turned it over. He smiled - there was a yellow ladder under the rock! He climbed the ladder and grabbed the apple. He was so happy! Once upon a time, there was a girl called Juliet.

Once there was a cat that liked to skip. He skipped around the house, everywhere he went. The cat was very happy and he enjoyed his skipping.
